title: PartnerFundRequest - Data API
description: Represents a request for funds from the partner marketing budget by a channel partner. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

Activity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Activity.description: Activity that is covered by the funds, for example, a trade show or seminar.

AllocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AllocationId.description: ID of the partner fund allocation.

BudgetId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BudgetId.description: ID of the partner marketing budget.

ChannelPartnerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ChannelPartnerId.description: ID of the channel partner. Note: The ChannelPartnerId field isn’t supported for formula fields, custom buttons, or custom links for the PartnerFundRequest object. This limitation also applies to the PartnerFundAllocation and PartnerMarketingBudget objects.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

DesiredOutcome.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DesiredOutcome.description: Desired outcome if requested funds are used.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last interacted with this record, directly or indirectly.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it's possible that the user only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of the fund request.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Nillable, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Status of the fund request. Values are: Draft Approved Rejected

TotalApprovedFcs.description: Total amount of approved fund claims.

TotalReimbursedFcs.description: Total amount of reimbursed fund claims.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **PartnerFundRequestFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **PartnerFundRequestHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **PartnerFundRequestOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **PartnerFundRequestShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
